competency.title: Validate robotic control — worked example
competency.outcome: Validate a claim about robotic control using a bounded robot-control trajectory. Use a small, fully specified worked case and then change one input.

topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: testing unsafe motion on live hardware

competency.practice_task: Produce a preregistered test protocol and evidence record grounded in a bounded robot-control trajectory.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a small, fully specified worked case and then change one input.
required_evidence: a preregistered test protocol and evidence record
Include the solved case and the changed-case prediction.
Report goal completion and collision count with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: testing unsafe motion on live hardware.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of robotic control.
Practice: a held-out challenge supports or rejects the claim.
Measurement: report goal completion and collision count against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for testing unsafe motion on live hardware; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
